The checked-in `.claude/settings.json` now sets `feedbackSurveyRate` to `0` and `feedbackDrafts` to `"off"`, so Claude Code never shows the session quality survey or feedback drafts in this repo. This applies to every Claude session opened in the checkout, agents and humans alike. Previously mngr only wrote these flags for agents on remote hosts, so local agents (and people) still got the prompts, which interrupt automated input and output.
